content.text:
I fixed the pricing page on phones. The three plan cards were staying in a three-column row below 720px, which made the page wider than the screen. I added `.plans` to the single-column list in the phone media query in `site/css/pages.css`, so the plans now stack.

The phone screenshot for pricing was the one visual test failing, and it passes now. The other visual tests and all the functional tests also pass. I didn't look at the page in a browser. The check is the match against the approved phone screenshot.

STATUS: DONE
